settings.description: How documents move between Work in Progress, Shared, Published and Archived in this project (ISO 19650).

general.enforceOff: Off: the transition table is stored but not enforced.

transitions.heading: State Transitions
transitions.empty: No transitions defined. When enforcement is on, a missing transition is forbidden.

upload.hint: Use another code, or upload a new version of that document.

standard.label: Document Code Standard
standard.none: None: only the folders' own naming standards
standard.help: Files in folders without a naming standard of their own take their document code from this standard, so a code is unique across the project from Work in Progress on.

conflicts.heading: Code Conflicts
conflicts.description: Files from before unique document codes whose code belongs to another document. They keep working; rename them to resolve the conflict.
conflicts.empty: No conflicts: every document code belongs to one document.

teams.description: A task team is a company's team in this project (ISO 19650). A WIP folder can be owned by one team; with "Owning Task Team Only" nobody outside the team sees it, whatever they inherit from parent folders.

policyHelp.grants: Folder permissions decide as set; owner teams are informative.
policyHelp.team_only: A team's WIP folder is closed outside the team. A permission for someone else on it is an exception with a reason.

teams.empty: No task teams yet. Create one per company, or let SiteKeep create them from the project's companies.
teams.deleteConfirm: Delete the task team "{{name}}"? Its memberships and folder permissions are removed; folders it owns get no owner.
teams.seeded_one: {{count}} team created; {{folders}} WIP folders got an owner team.
teams.seeded_other: {{count}} teams created; {{folders}} WIP folders got an owner team.

ownerTeam.label: Owner Task Team
ownerTeam.help: The team that works in this WIP folder. With "Owning Task Team Only" it is closed to everyone outside the team.

reason.title: Exception Outside the Task Team
reason.message: This is a WIP folder of task team "{{team}}". Giving access to someone outside the team is an exception and is recorded in the audit log. Why is it needed?

whoCanSee.note: Work in progress of task team "{{team}}" (folder "{{folder}}"): closed to everyone outside the team except exception permissions.

editor.title: Codes of V{{version}}
editor.noStateHelp: This folder has no CDE state: any code of the project's profile is accepted.
editor.reasonHelp: This version is in {{state}}. Changing its codes is an administrator override and is recorded in the audit log with the reason.

upload.heading: ISO 19650 Codes
upload.help: Applied to every file of this upload. {{state}}: suitability {{codes}}, revision form {{revision}}.
upload.noStateHelp: This folder has no CDE state: any code of the project's profile is accepted, or leave them empty.
upload.autoFill: Left empty, the project fills in the suitability and the next revision of each file.
upload.multipleVersions: Several files get new versions: leave the revision empty so each file gets its own next revision.

errors.suitabilityUnknown: {{value}} is not a suitability code of this project. Allowed here: {{allowed}}.
errors.suitabilityState: {{value}} cannot be used in {{state}}. Allowed here: {{allowed}}.
errors.revisionFormat: Revision {{value}} does not follow the project's revision scheme. Expected here: {{allowed}}.
errors.revisionState: Revision {{value}} cannot be used in {{state}}. Expected here: {{allowed}}.

schemeHelp.iso_uk_na: WIP: S0 with P01.01, P01.02 …; Shared: S1–S4 with P01, P02 …; Published: A1…An, B1…Bn, CR with C01, C02 …
schemeHelp.legacy_r: Revisions R00, R01 … in every state; suitability codes are not tied to a state.
schemeHelp.custom: ISO revisions with the project's own suitability codes.

settings.ownList: The project's own suitability list is used.
settings.unmappedHelp: Suitability and revision values from the older free attributes that are not codes of this profile. They stay in the attributes; set the codes of these versions by hand.

dialog.heading: State transition:
dialog.notEnforced: The project does not enforce the transitions: the copies keep the codes of the reviewed versions.

override.title: Override Transition: {{name}}
override.description: Moves the file into the chosen folder regardless of the transition table. Only project administrators can do this; the reason is stored in the audit log.

statusHints.returned: Sent back by a review: revise it and send it again.
statusHints.superseded: A newer version was published; this is the archived copy.
statusHints.withdrawn: The publication of this shared copy was refused.

transitionEditor.enforceHelp: On: direct uploads only where the table allows them, state changes only through the listed reviews, and project administrators too go through the override with a reason. Enterprise modules (Connect import, Office editing, Field, Manage) follow the same rules.
transitionEditor.archiveHelp: On a new publication the previous one is copied here, at the same path it had under Published.
transitionEditor.defaultsNote: The table is empty: while enforcement is on, the ISO 19650 default applies (upload into Work in Progress; Work in Progress → Shared → Published through any approved review).
